arguments.summary: Initial analysis indicates that the 502 errors were due to an ingress idle timeout, the certificate issue was caused by an expired intermediate certificate, and the cron drift was due to the container running on UTC time. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, and further investigation is required to determine the cause of job failures and resolve the backlog. The failed_jobs table will be exported using pg_dump for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the root cause of the failed jobs in the jobs database and resolve the backlog. Use pg_dump to export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem.
